description: Defines the ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams class, a data transfer object for filtering claim requests in the OrangeHRM system, including filter criteria and sorting options.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering and sorting claim request data, including employee inclusion criteria, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date range.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current employee inclusion filter setting.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the employee inclusion filter criterion.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID filter value.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID filter value.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the event ID filter value.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the event ID filter value.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter, adjusting time to 23:59:59.
